title: Bitcoin slides amid US tariff nerves as Anthropic falls below IPO price
summary: Bitcoin gave up gains above $60,000 as tariff concerns weighed on US stocks and Anthropic shares hit new lows below $76.

title: How South Korea’s proposed 20% cap could change who runs Upbit
summary: Naver Financial agreed to buy every share in Upbit’s operator, but a proposed ownership cap could strip away its voting rights on four-fifths of them.

title: USDT buyers face 22% VAT when Moscow Exchange opens crypto trading
summary: Buyers will pay VAT on top of the trade price in December because Russia’s tax code has no explicit exemption for foreign digital instruments.

title: Swiss central bank, UBS and SIX study ledger for tokenized settlement
summary: The study will assess whether a shared ledger can bring central bank money, commercial bank money and securities onto the same platform.

title: Sky lender proposes buyback of up to $50M to fund stUSDS withdrawals
summary: Borrowers would sell SKY to the protocol and use the proceeds to pay down their loans, freeing up funds for depositors in the stUSDS pool.

title: Grayscale calls Bitcoin ‘oversold’ at $62K but warns of AI risks
summary: Grayscale said Bitcoin’s bear market was its longest on record at 411 days and counting, though the 56% drop was the smallest percentage decline.

title: South Korea proposes bank-led stablecoins, 20% cap on crypto exchange stakes
summary: The draft bill would also reopen domestic initial coin offerings after a ban dating to 2017 and require issuers to disclose risks before soliciting buyers.

title: Bitcoin dipped on Huang’s Nvidia exit but jumped 5% on his return
summary: Bitcoin rose about 5% on Jensen Huang’s return, more than the 3.5% it lost on news of his exit, but remained 19.2% below its pre-resignation price.

title: Bitcoin dips back under $60K as gold seals worst 60-day loss since 1980s
summary: Bitcoin continued to threaten the loss of $60,000 support as gold attempted to bounce from a 60-day losing streak during which it fell nearly 25%.

title: Bitcoin ETFs keep bleeding as BlackRock’s IBIT shares gain nearly 5%
summary: BlackRock’s IBIT shares gained 4.85% on Monday despite continued Bitcoin ETF withdrawals that pushed November’s net outflows to $4.71 billion.
